title: Character
description: A character from the Breaking Bad or Better Call Saul television universe.

char_id.description: Unique numeric id for the character.

occupation.description: List of the character's known occupations.

img.description: URL of the character's portrait image (JPG).

status.description: Whether the character is alive, deceased, or presumed dead.

nickname.description: A known nickname for the character.

appearance.description: List of Breaking Bad seasons in which the character appeared.

category.description: Comma-separated list of series the character appears in.

better_call_saul_appearance.description: List of Better Call Saul seasons in which the character appeared.
